records.question: In each of the following questions, choose the option that has the same consonant sound as the one represented by the letter(s) underlined. Public Target: the initial P in Public.
records.explanation: The initial P in public represents /p/. Handicap contains the same sound at its end. Trophy and pharmacy use /f/, while the written initial p in psychology is silent.

records.question: Choose the option that best explains the information conveyed in the sentence. Tayo had to separate himself neck and crop from his old friend.
choices: He became scared of his old friend
He became suspicious of his old friend
He completely severed from his old friend
He completely forgave his old friend's offences
records.explanation: Neck and crop conveys completeness or thoroughness. Here it means Tayo completely broke off the friendship, rather than becoming frightened or suspicious or forgiving the friend.

observed_options.A: He became scared of his old friend
observed_options.B: He became suspicious of his old friend
observed_options.C: He completely severed from his old friend
observed_options.D: He completely forgave his old friend's offences

records.question: Choose the option that best explains the information conveyed in the sentence. One of the prerequisites for success in examination is burning the midnight oil.
choices: needs to study late into the night
one should burn all the candles
one needs to study at will
records.explanation: To burn the midnight oil means to work or study late into the night. Here the question tests the meaning of the idiom: it does not mean literal burning, staying awake all day, or studying at any chosen time. The idiom itself does not establish late-night study as a requirement for examination success.

observed_options.A: needs to study late into the night
observed_options.C: one should burn all the candles
observed_options.D: one needs to study at will

records.question: In each of the following questions, choose the option nearest in meaning to the word or phrase underlined. The board Chairman cherishes punctuality at the meeting. Target word: cherishes.
records.explanation: Cherishes means values highly or holds dear. In this context admires is the nearest of the four choices because it expresses approval; condemns, abhors, and despises express negative attitudes.

records.question: In each of the following questions, select the option that best completes the gap. The touts ____ arrested during the riot.
records.explanation: The plural subject the touts takes were in this passive sentence. Were arrested is a past passive construction. Was and is are singular forms, while where is a word about place rather than a form of be.

records.question: In each of the following questions, select the option that best completes the gap. The ripe orange was beyond his ______.
records.explanation: Beyond someone’s reach means too far away for that person to touch or get. Reach fits this distance expression; touch, catch, and pluck do not form the ordinary expression here.

records.question: In each of the following questions, select the option that best completes the gap. Take your share and give them _____
records.explanation: Theirs is an independent possessive pronoun standing for their share, and it has no apostrophe. There indicates a place; there’s abbreviates there is or there has; their’s is not the standard possessive form.

records.question: In each of the following questions, select the option that best completes the gap. The children chased all the _______ away.
records.explanation: Geese is the irregular plural of goose. The sentence describes living birds being chased, so it needs the plural geese rather than singular goose or the nonstandard forms gooses and geeses.

records.question: In each of the following questions, select the option that best completes the gap. To be alive after such a serious accident _____ a celebration.
records.explanation: The infinitive clause To be alive after such a serious accident functions as a singular subject. Calls for agrees with it and means warrants or deserves a celebration. Call for lacks singular agreement, while the passive options change the required meaning.
